name: Wyndham Rewards Earner Premier Card

apr.notes: Purchase APR 19.49% to 29.99% variable; cash advance APR 29.99% variable. 0% promotional APR for 6 billing cycles on Wyndham Timeshare Purchases; 0% intro APR for 15 billing cycles on balance transfers posted within 45 days of opening.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.

base_rate.description: 1 point per $1 on all other purchases (excluding Wyndham Vacation Club down payments).

categories.label: Hotels by Wyndham, including Wyndham Travel Bundles
Dining, grocery stores (excluding Target and Walmart) and travel

rewards.redemption_notes: Free nights from 3,750 points with 25% fewer points required; points also redeem for online shopping and gift cards.

signup_bonus.description: 90,000 bonus points after spending $6,000 and paying the annual fee within the first 120 days, plus 30,000 bonus points after spending $750 at Hotels by Wyndham in the first 180 days.

benefits.title: Anniversary bonus points
benefits.description: 30,000 bonus points each anniversary year after payment of the annual fee.

benefits.title: Wyndham Rewards Diamond status
benefits.description: Automatic Wyndham Rewards Diamond member level.

benefits.title: Wyndham hotel statement credit
benefits.description: $100 statement credit after spending $100 or more at eligible Wyndham hotel brands each calendar year.

benefits.title: Meal delivery credit
benefits.description: Up to $10 in statement credits each month (up to $120 per calendar year) on qualifying meal delivery purchases.

benefits.title: Streaming credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 in statement credits each calendar year on qualifying streaming service purchases.

benefits.title: Wholesale club membership credit
benefits.description: $65 statement credit each calendar year after qualifying wholesale club membership purchases.

benefits.title: TSA PreCheck or Global Entry credit
benefits.description: Up to $120 statement credit every 4 years for the application fee.

notes: Issued by Barclays Bank Delaware. The page's offer terms refer to the Wyndham Rewards Visa Signature credit card, so network_tier is signature.
